select id,name as value,name,code,disabled,index from ( select dp.id, dp.name, dp.code, dp.disabled, dp.index from dict_partition dp where dp.is_deleted = false
and dp.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%')
and dp.disabled=#{params.disabled}
order by dp.disabled asc,
case when dp.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when dp.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when dp.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , dp.name,
dp.index asc ) dps
